validation_environment.pdf_dependency: pypdf 5.x or 6.x; PDF-specific test not run in this validation

queries.query: What information should I prepare before an appointment?
What should I do before taking an unfamiliar medicine?
What should someone do for severe breathing difficulty?

retrieval_evaluation.note: Tiny hand-authored retrieval smoke set for the synthetic corpus; not clinical validation.

verified_behaviors: Local sparse TF-IDF-style vectors and cosine ranking
Source citations in returned extractive evidence
Abstention for queries with no relevant indexed vocabulary
Urgent-symptom query retrieves the intended demo safety note
Command-line query returns structured JSON on request
limitations: The included corpus is synthetic educational demo content and is not an authoritative clinical reference.
The term-weighted vector index is lexical and can miss synonyms or semantic matches.
Retrieval evaluation uses three hand-authored queries; it is not clinical validation.
PDF ingestion implementation depends on pypdf and was not exercised in this validation run.
The tool is not a diagnosis, triage or treatment decision system.
